synth_small: synthetic cme MBO dataset generated by queuetruth-testkit (no market data).

Regenerate: make fixtures (cargo run --locked --release -p queuetruth-testkit --example make_fixtures);
MANIFEST.sha256 lists every file (shasum -a 256 -c MANIFEST.sha256).

Generator: qt_testkit::generate_sessions_with(fixture_config(cme), 2, Some(QueueMix::REALISTIC)): 30% of cancels and partial cancels from the front of the queue, 25% from its front half, the rest uniform, 25% of modifies queue-jumping re-quotes; seed 7; 2 instruments; 27500 events per instrument and session; tick 250000000 and base price 5000000000000 at price_exp -9; up to 10 levels per side; mean order size 4; weights add 0.42, cancel 0.28, reduce 0.06, modify 0.08, sweep 0.13, snapshot clear 0.0002, hidden print 0; snapshot at start true; mean event gap 894545454 ns.
Session: time zone UTC, open 48600 s, close 72000 s after local midnight; data runs from 5 minutes before the open to about 15 minutes after the close.

Layout: manifest.json, instruments.parquet, data_quality.json, mbo/date=*/instrument_id=*/part-00000.parquet (qt.mbo, feed order), trades_source/... (qt.trades, the T records), truth/ (independent expectations: shadows.parquet + amends.parquet = a seeded schedule of 250 shadows per partition with abs and touch prices, latency, cancels and amends; shadow_results / shadow_fills / queue_trajectory (ahead) from qt_testkit::try_reference_shadows with the replay defaults; bbo.parquet = bbo full mode, one row per event).

Partitions (date, instrument, records, events, trade prints, hidden prints):
  2026-06-15 instrument 1: 49820 records, 27500 events, 4088 prints, 0 hidden
  2026-06-15 instrument 2: 50246 records, 27500 events, 4067 prints, 0 hidden
  2026-06-16 instrument 1: 50224 records, 27500 events, 4180 prints, 0 hidden
  2026-06-16 instrument 2: 49592 records, 27500 events, 4092 prints, 0 hidden

Audit inputs (binding rulings in docs/concepts/audit-rules.md):
- own_orders/ (A1): 200 real order lives of this tape (up to 50 per partition, 139 with fills) taken as the user's own orders: live/ is their canonical live log (venue cme, account SYNTH, venue_order_id = MBO order_id, 879 events), schedule.parquet the exact-arm schedule (ts_submit = ack = add time, ts_cancel = cancel ack), expected_results / expected_fills the reference replay with these order ids excluded from the tape. Expected scorer result for sim = exact with self-exclusion: zero discordance (every live fill reproduced at the same event); without exclusion the twin sits ahead of its own shadow and live-only discordance appears.
- truth/censoring_sim_results.parquet + truth/censoring_sim_predictions.parquet (A2): 20000 simulated orders (fill time ~ Exp(30 s) via qt_testkit::dist, shared cancel ~ U(0, 120 s) as ts_cancel_effective, horizon 60 s) and a predictor perfectly calibrated for these draws (model_id calibrated_oracle, censored = false). Expected: fill-rate bias about 0 over all rows; about -0.12 if unfilled rows cancelled before the horizon are dropped.
